New owner/write checks and observer chmod change observable modes, ACL masks and ctime, and can refuse readable ordinary states the original walk accepted. L_REFUSAL names G4 failures while HELLO lacks that frame. The common STOP rule also demands REFUSAL in states where the row does not list it (adopt INPUTS and seal FRONT_TERMINAL). Complete every legal early refusal and STOP branch without inventing no-target evidence.

required_corrections.correction: A fully written primary marker followed by a failed close is followed by a continuation linked to that primary. The continuation confirms the original primary under the new chain rule, while carried retain semantics downgrade on any step-3 failure and consumer precedence selects a committed primary over retry. P-CHAIN explicitly expects a torn close to leave the record committed. Reconcile this with the failed-primary raw/never-parsed guarantee and the three-write primitive; retain every failure and downgrade for all consumers.

New storage readings are frozen author-reported readings, not independently observed fresh capacity by this review. No live storage/vault/systemd call was made; relay claims, incomplete D1 review and live STATUS are not seals.

The current C-API v6 summary reports closure at design level, but its later unqualified Next sentence still says R2_NINE_CONDITIONS and PACKET_PLAN remain NOT_CLOSED and v6 review is next. 3.assessment: As composed, W-1 v5 cannot yet meet V5-B01 and V5-B02 together: its new revocation is not proven confined at mutation time or preserving of the original accepted behavior, and protocol, journal, reconciliation and image-pin specifications remain inconsistent. The protected writer tree, complete final leaf pass, conditional quiescence/credential closure, external setup seal and non-gating release repairs are plausible parts of a successor, but require a coherent corrected specification, independent successor-frame review and installed evidence without an exception.

findings.detail: New O mutation includes mode/ACL mask/ctime changes; K1 admits a new outside name before fchmodat2 and only refuses afterward. Anchored fd is inode identity, not exclusive tree naming at the mutation.

c2 and regular-file single-link c5 are present in original v5/v6 walks. c4 set-ID refusal and directory same-device c5 are absent; c1 ownership and c3 no-write plus revocation are not the full new surface. Owner access does not preserve observed mode/ACL/time/output or granted collaboration behavior. Existing compatibility hypotheses cannot narrow accepted cases.

M-QUIESCENT Q1-Q8 covers jobs, unit state, refs, connections, queues and pending work. S1-S6 cover process/job sources, dispatch order, drained internal work, reply/connection ordering and protected routes; stronger than serialized API calls alone. Requires applicable installed-version source review plus probes; finite equal snapshots do not prove it. No premise is observed or accepted here.

K3 names sudo, M inheritance, no minted set-ID/capabilities, locked group passwords, subordinate identities and trusted root. S-F explicitly sets PAMName empty, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, NoNewPrivileges, RestrictSUIDSGID, native syscall architecture and io_uring ENOSYS denial; masks cover every loaded process-starting unit file including static/disabled/templates/aliases. Target C9 denies io_uring as well as set-ID requests and openat2; filter completeness and original behavior remain H1-H3 and compatibility obligations.

Spawn permission/failure and release directions repaired, but C pre-HELLO and pre-ADMIT CHILD_REFUSAL, L HELLO/G4 L_REFUSAL and STOP/REFUSAL in adopt INPUTS or seal FRONT_TERMINAL are not legal in the enumerated complete tables. Missing start never means nothing started.

One chain, gap/branch/genesis/cut and raw-export rules substantially improved. But a failed close after a fully written primary leads J4 continuation to confirm that primary; P-CHAIN wants it committed, while carried three-step retain downgrades on the failed step and committed primary wins over retry. All consumers need a single rule preserving raw failed-primary/non-success truth.
F owns release and writes at the bounded control deadline; INTENT result may arrive late and changes nothing. UNKNOWN withholds success but alone adds neither a release hold nor approval gate.

S excludes itself; S-I external file tuple/digest is sealed by installed review, adopted into later records and rechecked. Materialization has expressly unadopted bookkeeping before comparison; this is not installed admission.

Full short-write/fsync/torn-log handling and direct producer exit-status handling fix prior defects. E-prefix observation conflicts with later ACL atoms intentionally changing earlier directory E=no ACL/mode; check/service-action class has no distinct E. Specify reachable phase-aware state vectors and partial reversals across setup and rollback; expected future numeric IDs/captures are not the defect.

Search-only root:W 0710 permits named backing-file observation conditional on LOOKUP; lost+found has an explicit pinned special-entry rule. New exact directory entry-set pin is compared at every use although W/W2 cannot list it, and no privileged per-use comparison is specified.

A hypothetical no-use compatibility claim, a finite run, or operator agreement is no replacement.

findings.detail: K1 admits an outside name before its mutation and then refuses. Removing write access, recording it and not changing content do not exempt this frame mutation from V5-B02.

findings.risk: Ambiguous failed-record truth or omitted failure transition
findings.detail: Every reader/consumer needs one failed-close rule that preserves failed-primary raw/downgrade and errors, and every refusal needs a legal state. Global error joins and verb-specific success already withhold final success; this review does not claim a proven end-to-end false-success execution. Missing starts/refusals or a confirmed primary must not hide original failure evidence.

findings.risk: Premise accepted as assumption or finite probe accepted as proof
findings.detail: K7 expressly requires redesign and says finite probes can refute but not establish premises. Installed systemd/kernel/filter/source and compatible-frame evidence remain required. No operator choice may turn an unverified premise into a contract axiom or exception.

findings.risk: Weakened target through an offered alternative
findings.detail: Package plainly declares lowering task reserve/scope/warnings, removing Ghost helpers, capping native/decimal domains, refusing formerly valid values or selecting release to suppress checked code ineligible. Equivalent-reference claims excuse no caller/control; independent reviews, strict formal/native/cost, original ordinary and fault floors remain. No such choice is made.
